death.note: doxologia.ro: «Sfântul Mucenic Avudin († 303-305) a primit cununa muceniciei în timpul împăratului Diocleţian (284-305)».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 июля ст. ст. — «Мч. Авудима (IV).»

attestations.note: The day's fourth entry. The folder's GREEK row already stands on this very menologion day, the 15th, and its Romanian row on the 16th — one row per church and neither moved. Name page 42 is «Авудим Тенедосский, мч.», and TENEDOS IS WHAT THIS CALENDAR ADDS: the folder's display name is the bare «Abudimus» because neither doxologia nor saint.gr gave him a place. It is recorded here and the folder was NOT renamed. `dates` UNCHANGED: the line gives «(IV)» where the folder holds 303–305 off doxologia.ro's own words, and the century contains that interval rather than contradicting it. NO READING: the day page links no life page for this entry, and the day page prints no hymn under his name.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 16 iulie — «Sfântul Mucenic Avudin»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 15ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Αβούδιμος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους». That is one day before the 16 iulie the folder's Romanian row carries off doxologia: the two calendars keep him a day apart, each row records its own source, and nothing is moved. The man is the folder's own — the martyr of the Diocletian persecution whom doxologia calls Avudin — and the Greek page adds the island of Tenedos as his home, the beating, the tearing of his sides with iron claws, his one answer «Είμαι Χριστιανός», I am a Christian, and his beheading. It gives no year: «στον τότε διωγμό κατά της Εκκλησίας επί Διοκλητιανού», the persecution under Diocletian and no date for it, so the folder's `dates`, read off doxologia as 303-305, are left as they stand and nothing is proposed for them. He is not `eudemus-of-georgia` or `vadim-of-persia`, which the name sweep raised: both carry other names on other days. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The page prints no hymn.
